name: Clever Communications
summary: Wireless broadband carrier (ASX: APV, later CVA); founded 2001 as Access Providers; acquired Saise Telecom (2005) and Activ Australia (2006); renamed Clever Communications 19 Jul 2007; SMB assets to M2 (2010); acquired by BigAir Dec 2010/Jan 2011 (CLEVER COMMUNICATIONS AUSTRALIA PTY LIMITED, ACN 103 623 356).
